scenario_info.description: Multi-agent simulation of cultural region emergence driven by individual openness and spatial information flow in a spatially explicit society.

metrics.name: num_cultural_regions
metrics.description: Number of distinct cultural regions identified by spatial clustering of agents with highly similar trait sets.

metrics.name: region_size_distribution
metrics.description: Distribution of sizes (number of agents) of all identified cultural regions.

metrics.name: average_cultural_similarity
metrics.description: Average pairwise cultural similarity between neighboring agents across the grid.

metrics.name: trait_adoption_events
metrics.description: Total number of cultural trait adoption events per simulation step.

metrics.name: convergence_time
metrics.description: Number of steps until the number and composition of cultural regions stabilize.
